thread:
rachel: Heads-up  Sales got a request for a thinner "pin ecosystem" product: predictable pins + simple pricing + automated migration credits. Need a quick spec sketch.

tom: Summarize must-haves?

rachel: Customer asks: tenant pin (max 180d), a clear cost for long pins, automatic migration credits if we retire, and a short ops SLA for emergency unpin.

emily: Pricing idea: three tiers: Free (30d), Standard (90d), Extended (180d). Flat monthly fee per pinned model + per-day reserved capacity surcharge for Extended.

oz: Ops note: extended pins require reserved capacity mapping. Also add a compatibility check that rejects pins for models lacking deterministic quantization or kernel support.

rachel: Bench gates to accept a pin? propose: canonical harness = seq512, 200 samples. Acceptance: gen p95 <= 180ms (Standard) / <=120ms (Extended). Embedding drift <= 4% vs baseline.

emily: Automation: run "pin-preflight" CI that runs bench + smoke routing + eval. If pass, create pin record with audit fields: pinned_by, reason, approval_ticket. If fail, return actionable errors.

billing-bot: Billing export fields requested: pin_tier, pin_fee, reserved_surcharge, pin_reason, pin_expiry. Invoice line for migration credits when applied.

legal: Add clause: upstream model changes may trigger emergency unpin; we will notify customer and apply migration credits per SLA. Also need retention KMS wording for Private installs.

tom: Migration credits: suggest 60 days free credits on first forced migration, smaller prorated credits for subsequent. Also provide a migration-runner CLI in Console for customers to preview.

oz: Telemetry to add: pinned_p95, pinned_cost_delta, pin_fallback_count, pin_suspended_flag. Alert: pinned_eval_fail_rate > 2% -> paging.

rachel: UX: Console should show pin card with tier, expiry countdown, region, strict_mode toggle, and one-click request extension. Also surface compatibility check at pin time.

emily: Rollout plan: spec -> SDK flag -> canary (10 tenants) -> GA. Owners: emily (spec + CI), oz (infra), tom (pricing), legal (contract). Target: draft in 1 week.

rachel: Quick decision points: default TTL = 90d, paid extensions up to 180d, Extended requires reserved capacity + signed SOW. Team ok?

tom: +1. I'll sketch pricing bands and example invoices.

legal: Will prepare contract stubs for enterprise Extended SKU and an emergency-unpin template.

rachel: Great. Using this thread as the working notes. I'll create the tracking doc and ticket after lunch. Thanks all :thumbsup:
